lines: I handle the team's technology. The TEMPORAL CAPSULE creates a safe field around the creature.
It doesn't hurt anyone: the creature is studied for a few moments and then returned to its own time.
The portal to PREHISTORIC BRAZIL is to the east, past the lab door. Good expedition!
repeat_lines: In every encounter you carry 3 capsules. Use them carefully!

lines: I'm from Biology. Use SCAN first: it shows the species' habitat and diet.
The more data you have, the stronger the tracking signal gets.
repeat_lines: Biology tip: always scan before throwing a capsule.

lines: I handle the team's communication: I turn what we discover into stories for everyone. In the Pleistocene, Brazil was home to giant sloths, saber-toothed cats and much more.
Most of that megafauna disappeared at the end of the last ice age, about 11 thousand years ago.
The ECODEX only reveals a species' Fun Fact and History after you study it up close.
repeat_lines: Record every species. Each one tells a piece of Brazil's history.

lines: I'm Felipe, the team leader. I make sure everyone comes back in one piece from every expedition.
Before traveling through time, talk to Prof. Proença: he has new equipment for the expedition.
repeat_lines: Good luck out there in the Pleistocene! We'll be at the base waiting for you.

placa_base.name: Sign
lines: TIME BASE. Portal to PREHISTORIC BRAZIL (Pleistocene): follow the trail east.
My job is tracking. Tall grass hides footprints: walk through it and something will show up.
Use TRACK to strengthen the signal before throwing the capsule.
repeat_lines: Fresh tracks in the tall grass, on the other side of the portal!

lines: I plan the team's strategy. Golden rule: don't spend all your capsules at once.
The temporal signal lasts only a few turns in each encounter. Track with a plan.
repeat_lines: Planning is everything: scan, track and only then throw the capsule.

placa_pleisto.name: Sign
lines: PLEISTOCENE. Creatures hide in the tall grass. The portal back is to the west.
